Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

1 . Scope -- Covers the dimensions for bonded abrasive grinding wheels, other than internal grinding 
wheels, 

2. Dimensions — The dimensions of grinding wheels shall be as given in 2.1 to 2.10. The ISO sizes 
specified in the tables are preferred sizes* whereas non-ISO sizes are non-preferred. 

2.1 Plain Grinding Wljeels, Type / — ( For low and high speed fettling and general sharpening, for the 
use on fixed, portable, swing frame, external cylindrical, surface grinding and crank shaft grinding 
machines.)

3. Plastic Bushes — For grinding wheels less than outside diameter 350 mm and thickness greater 
than 10 mm, plastic bushes may be used, so as to have different hole diameters. The recommended 
sizes of the plastic bushes are given in 3.2. 

3.1 Plastic bushes are recommended to be used for types of grinding wheels covered under 2.1.1, 
2.1.2, 2.7» 2.8 and 2.9.

4. Tolerance 

4.1 Tolerances on the hole diameter H of the grinding wheels shall be as given below. 

4.1.1 Precision grinding wheels 

General application— HI 2 
Special application — H11 

4.1 .2 Non-precision grinding wheels 

( Forlexample : fettling, snagging wheels) HI 3 



18 



IS : 2324 ( Part 2 ) -1985 

4.2 The tolerances on the outside diameter, thickness and recess diameter shall be as agreed to 
between the purchaser and the maunfacturer. 

6. Designation — The designation of grinding wheels shall consist of indications of the shape, 
dimensions and specifications of the internal nature of the product in that order. 

The indication of the shapes is given by 'Type', If necessary by profile. For details of profiles and 
types; reference may be made to IS: 2324 (Part 1)-1 985 'Bonded abrasive grinding wheels : Part 1 
Profiles and types'. 

For the dimensions in the designation, the diameter D, thickness T and hole diameter ^ are 
indicated by their numerical values only. The specification of the internal nature of the grinding wheel 
shall be in accordance with IS : 551-1966 'Marking system for grinding wheels'. 

Example : 

A Plain grinding wheel Type 1, outside dia D 300 mm, thickness T 50 mm, hole dia /V 
76'2 mm, abrasive aluminium oxide (A), grain size 36, grade L, structure 5, with vitrified bond 
(V) shall be designated as: 

Wheel Type 1 300x50x762 A 36 L S V 

(Shape) (Dimension) (Specifications) 

6. Marking — Each grinding wheel shall be marked in accordance with IS : 551-1966. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard, 'Dimensions for grinding whpels (other than internal grinding wheels)' IS : 2324 
was first published in 1963 and first revision was done in 1971, incorporating the additional sizes, 
based on the existing machinery available in the country. 

The current revision has been taken up to bring it in line with the work done at ISO level. For 
the profiles and types of the bonded abrasive grinding wheels, a separate Indian Standard 
IS : 2324 (Part 1)-1985 has been formulated. 

This part of the standard deals with the dimensions and tolerances of the abrasive grinding 
wheels. Dimensions of internal grinding wheels, depressed centre wheels and mounted points have 
not been covered in this standard, since these have already been covered in IS : 9291-1979 
'Dimensions for internal grinding wheels'; IS : 8915-1978 'Dimensions for depressed centre wheels. 
Type 27'; and IS : 3300-1980 'Dimensions for mounted points, respectively. 

While revising the sizes, which are unpopular and redundent, have been eliminated and at the 
same time sizes which are popular and widely used in the country have been included in the separate 
table, as non-ISO sizes {non-preferred). The recommended sizes of the plastic bushes which are 
commonly being used, are also included in the standard for the guidence of the users. 

ISO sizes ( preferred) are those sizes which are given in relevant ISO documents. White preparing 
this specification, considerable assistance has also been derived from: 

ISO 603/2-1981 'Bonded abrasive products ^ Grinding wheel dimensions — Part 2 : Cutting off 
wheels. Type 1 

ISO 1117-1975 'Bonded abrasive products— Grinding wheel dimensions', issued by the Inter- 
national Organization for Standardization (ISO). 

It is recommended that machine tools to be manufactured in the country be designed as far as 
possible to adopt the dimensions of the grinding wheels which are covered in tables as ISO sizes. In 
case, if the machines are imported, it is requested that these machines should be procured with ISO 
size grinding wheels. 

In the interest of grinding wheel industry in the country, it is also recommended that wherever 
practicable, the existing machines should be re-designed to adopt the ISO sizes grinding wheels. 

19
